[Verse] (dreamy female vocals, ethereal synth pads)
The skyline is bleeding into a ghost of grey
I’m watching the billboards just melting away
The rearview mirror holds a life I don't know
Where the shadows are heavy and the streetlights are slow.

[Chorus] (driving upbeat beat, soaring synth)
So I’m chasing the static on the edge of the line
Leaving the heartache and the city behind
One foot on the pedal, my heart in the haze
Trading the neon for the endless night gaze.

[Verse] (steady driving bass, 80s retro vibe)
The radio arches through the hum of the lane
A lonely melody to wash out theAIN
I’m shedding my nombre, I’m burning the map
Falling out of the rhythm, into the gap.

[Chorus] (driving upbeat beat, soaring synth)
So I’m chasing the static on the edge of the line
Leaving the heartache and the city behind
One foot on the pedal, my heart in the haze
Trading the neon for the endless night gaze.

[Bridge] (atmospheric synth swell, stripped back)
It’s not a goodbye, it’s just a long run
Tired of the shadows, looking for the sun
The road is an ocean, the headlights my guide
With nothing but distance on my side.

[Chorus] (driving upbeat beat, soaring synth)
So I’m chasing the static on the edge of the line
Leaving the heartache and the city behind
One foot on the pedal, my heart in the haze
Trading the neon for the endless night gaze.

[Outro] (fading synth echoes, rhythmic beat)
Endless night gaze.
The city is fading...
Fading away.
